displayServer: native renderer (OpenGL 4.1 Metal, Apple M3 Pro, Compatibility renderer)

exampleValidation.note: the example's own validation saves the 'initial' and 'narrow' frames; both precede any press, and each judges the painted ink against the reported lines

pressDriver.note: the driver is not project code: it instantiates the example's scene, clicks the paragraph with actual Godot mouse input and waits on the conditions the example reports
checkNames: The example mounted its pressable paragraph and its first layout
The paragraph is painted in 1d4ed8 in the before frame
The paragraph's text has painted ink in the before frame
While the mouse is down onPressIn has run and the paragraph is painted in its held blue
The paragraph is painted in 1e3a8a in the held frame
The paragraph's text has painted ink in the held frame
After the release onPress and onPressOut have run and the paragraph says pressed 1 times in its resting blue
The paragraph is painted in 1d4ed8 in the after frame
The paragraph's text has painted ink in the after frame
One press in, one press and one press out reached React, press in first
The run raised no host error

determinism: each command ran twice in a row on the pinned commit and saved the very same bytes for every frame; the driver's before frame is byte-identical to the example's initial frame

initial.source: node scripts/check.mjs --text-layout --capture (frame 'initial' of the example's own validation)
initial.description: the example at rest: the pressable paragraph says pressed 0 times in its resting blue

narrow.source: node scripts/check.mjs --text-layout --capture (frame 'narrow' of the example's own validation)
narrow.description: after the click that narrows the column: the paragraphs wrap again and the pressable paragraph still says pressed 0 times

held.source: capture-press.gd.txt (the driver, real mouse down held)
held.description: the mouse is down on the pressable paragraph: onPressIn has run and it is painted in its held blue

after.source: capture-press.gd.txt (the driver, after the real release)
after.description: after the release: onPress and onPressOut have run, the paragraph says pressed 1 times and is back in its resting blue
